question: What is the primary purpose of nursing research in a clinical setting?

options.A: To increase the cost of hospital admissions
options.B: To generate indigenous data for better patient care
options.C: To eliminate the need for clinical documentation
options.D: To replace doctors in diagnosing complex illnesses

explanation: Local research creates evidence that directly addresses specific healthcare challenges and patient needs within the environment. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T5#GNS217_U2_T5_h1)

question: Why is relying solely on foreign healthcare guidelines problematic in Nigerian hospitals?

options.A: Nigerian hospitals lack the electricity to read foreign journals
options.B: Foreign guidelines ignore local disease profiles and infrastructure
options.C: International guidelines are always written in difficult medical jargon
options.D: Foreign guidelines forbid nurses from practicing independently

explanation: Different regions face unique tropical diseases and resource limits that require locally tested nursing interventions. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T5#GNS217_U2_T5_h1)

question: What is a common research role for a bedside staff nurse?

options.A: Approving ethical clearance for all hospital studies
options.B: Collecting data and identifying clinical problems

explanation: Bedside nurses work closest to patients, making them best suited to spot practical problems and gather accurate study data. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T5#GNS217_U2_T5_h2)

question: How do clinical nurse specialists support evidence use on hospital wards?

options.A: By punishing staff who do not read medical journals
options.B: By replacing traditional nursing with purely administrative tasks
options.C: By translating research findings into daily bedside protocols
options.D: By conducting all hospital research without assistance

explanation: Specialists help staff understand complex study results and guide them on how to apply those findings safely in patient care. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T5#GNS217_U2_T5_h2)

question: What is the main difference between nursing research and evidence-based practice?

options.A: There is no difference between the two terms
options.B: Research is done at the bedside while EBP is done in a laboratory
options.C: Research generates new knowledge while EBP applies existing findings
options.D: EBP is only performed by doctors while research is for nurses

explanation: Research discovers facts, whereas evidence-based practice uses those discovered facts to improve daily nursing care. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T5#GNS217_U2_T5_h3)

question: A nurse wants to know if warm saline is better than cold saline for wound cleaning. What is the first step in the EBP process?

options.A: Immediately change the ward wound care policy
options.B: Formulate a clinical question about wound cleaning
options.C: Ask patients what temperature they prefer
options.D: Publish a textbook on wound management

explanation: The EBP process always begins by asking a well-defined clinical question to guide the literature search. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T5#GNS217_U2_T5_h3)

question: What does the ethical principle of autonomy mean for a research participant?

options.A: The protection from any physical side effects
options.B: The right to freely choose to participate or withdraw
options.C: The guarantee of receiving financial payment for the study
options.D: The obligation to finish the study once started

explanation: Autonomy ensures that participants retain full control over their involvement without fear of losing standard medical care. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T5#GNS217_U2_T5_h4)

question: Why is protecting vulnerable populations particularly important in Nigerian healthcare research?

options.A: To ensure that only wealthy patients participate in clinical trials
options.B: To make the ethical approval process faster and easier
options.C: To prevent exploitation of patients due to poverty or low literacy
options.D: To guarantee that the hospital receives foreign research grants

explanation: Vulnerable individuals may feel coerced to participate if they believe their medical treatment depends on it. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T5#GNS217_U2_T5_h4)

question: Which factor is a major barrier to nursing research in Nigerian clinical settings?

options.A: Mandatory daily research classes for all staff
options.B: An excess of funding and research grants
options.D: Heavy clinical workloads and staffing shortages

explanation: When nurses are overwhelmed with direct patient care due to staff shortages, finding time for research is extremely difficult. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T5#GNS217_U2_T5_h5)

question: How does poor access to online scientific databases affect clinical nursing development?

options.A: It forces nurses to rely entirely on electronic patient records
options.B: It prevents nurses from administering basic medications
options.C: It increases the cost of nursing council licensing exams
options.D: It limits the ability of nurses to conduct thorough literature reviews

explanation: Without access to current global research, nurses struggle to base their local practices on up-to-date scientific evidence. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T5#GNS217_U2_T5_h5)

question: What is the primary purpose of a hospital ward journal club?

options.A: To punish nurses who make clinical documentation errors
options.B: To discuss current research articles in an open environment
options.C: To raise funds for hospital equipment repairs
options.D: To record daily patient drug administration logs

explanation: Journal clubs build confidence and critical appraisal skills by helping nurses read and discuss research together. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T5#GNS217_U2_T5_h6)

question: Why is academic and clinical collaboration essential for promoting nursing research?

options.A: It ensures that university lecturers do any work on hospital wards
options.B: It connects theoretical classroom knowledge with actual bedside realities
options.C: It prevents clinical nurses from ever writing research papers
options.D: It reduces the need for ethical approval in student projects

explanation: Working together allows educators and bedside nurses to study relevant clinical problems and apply solutions effectively. [learn more](GNS217_U2_T5#GNS217_U2_T5_h6)
